text: Photography is the art of capturing moments through the lens of a camera. It involves using a camera to record images. By adjusting various aspects of the camera, such as the shutter and aperture, photographers can manipulate the exposure and depth of field to achieve specific effects. For example, they can create a sharp image with a blurred background or produce a dreamy, artistic effect with a wide-angle shot. With practice and patience, photographers can master their craft and produce stunning images that tell stories and evoke emotions.
